feature.goal: single consistent grandfather professor cutout with smooth frame animation
hard_rules: Only one professor character is allowed.
The character identity must remain fixed across all assets.
The final app should show only the professor cutout on the app background.
No speech bubble, stage, panel, or generated backdrop should remain in the final cutout assets.

interaction_rules: Idle while no new line is being revealed.
Speaking when the user clicks next or when autoplay reveals a new line.
Pointing only during subtopic transition emphasis.

visual_direction.character_brief: cute 3-head chibi grandfather professor, warm and playful, Korean lecture mascot energy, rounded face, kind eyebrows, slightly elderly but charming, premium mobile app style
global_constraints: same face and same outfit across every frame
no props except subtle hand gesture changes
plain solid light mint background for extraction
soft 3D render, not photorealistic, not flat 2D
no text, no speech bubble, no scene background

animation_sets.usage: default idle breathing and blinking loop

generation_sequence.prompt_seed: cute 3D cartoon grandfather professor mascot, 3-head chibi proportions, kind smile, relaxed neutral pose, one character only
